newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Youth jailed for hitching ride from cops.
newsitem.headline: Youth jailed for hitching ride from cops.

text.p: A man who tried to hitch a ride from the police in southern Argentina said on Monday he was fingerprinted, photographed and jailed for a night.
Omar Bastarrica, 20, was told that asking the police for a lift constituted a "lack of respect".

"I asked them if they could take me to the (train) station. Their response was that they forced me into their car and kept me detained for 10 hours," the state-run Telam news agency quoted him as saying.
"They had me sign papers which I presume will circulate all over the place and I'll end up with a record as if I were a criminal just for hitching a ride from the police," he said.
Bastarrica said he came from a distant village in central Argentina where "if you hitch a ride from a patrol car they'll take you without a problem."
Police in Puerto Madryn, where Bastarrica was detained on Saturday night, told Telam he was held for a record check but declined to elaborate.
